aliases: Why do you need a session plan?

one_line_answer.text: A session plan is the trainer's written guide for logical and sequential training.

cites.quote: A session plan is a written guide used by the trainer to help ensure training is conducted in a logical and sequential manner.

keywords.bn: প্রোগ্রামের একটি ছোট অংশ বা lesson
session শেষে learner যা অর্জন করবে

bangla_explanation: Session plan হলো trainer-এর লেখা guide, যাতে training logical আর sequential হয়।
বড় training program একবারে শেখানো যায় না, তাই ছোট ছোট session-এ ভাগ করা হয়।
প্রতিটি session-এর outcomes, practice activities, environment আর assessment methods আগে ঠিক করুন।
Plan থাকলে জানবেন কোথায় আছেন আর কোথায় যাবেন, পরে নিজের performance review-ও করা যায়।

example.en: A baking trainer writes session 04: cool, decorate and stack butter biscuits. It lists outcomes, demonstration, practice and review.
example.bn: প্রতিটি ক্লাসের আগে এমন একটি লিখিত session plan রাখুন।

list_answer.title: Why a session plan is needed

items.text: It documents the session structure and keeps track of where the session is going.

cites.quote: A session plan provides documentation of the session structure. It helps you keep track of where the session is going and where it has been.

items.text: It gives the trainer an idea of where they are and where they are going.

cites.quote: It gives you as the trainer an idea of where they are and where they are going.

items.text: It gives the trainer and the learners a clear idea of what they are doing.

cites.quote: It gives you as the trainer and the learners a clear idea of what they are doing.

items.text: It records the training session that the learners have taken.

cites.quote: It records the training session that the learners have taken.

items.text: It gives the trainers a firm base to review their performance.

cites.quote: Gives the trainers a firm base to review their performance.

items_bn: Session-এর কাঠামো লিখিত থাকে, তাই session কোথা থেকে এসেছে আর কোথায় যাচ্ছে তা track করা যায়।
Trainer বুঝতে পারেন এখন কোথায় আছেন আর এরপর কোথায় যেতে হবে, ফলে পথ হারান না।
Trainer আর learners দুই পক্ষই পরিষ্কার জানেন তারা কী করছেন।
Learners কোন কোন training session করেছে, তার লিখিত হিসাব থেকে যায়।
পরে trainer নিজের performance review করার একটি শক্ত ভিত্তি পান।

traps.text: A session plan considers information, outcomes, practice activities, environment, delivery approach and assessment methods.

cites.quote: The information that the trainer wants to present to the participants.
The learning outcomes to be achieved in the session.
The practise activities and tasks that will help trainees develop the competency.
The training environment and equipment required for skill development.
The delivery approach and techniques.
Assessment methods as prescribed in the Assessment Guideline.

traps.text: A program is the overall framework. It is broken into shorter sessions.

cites.quote: A training course or program is the overall framework for the training.
so it is broken up into a series of shorter training sessions/lesson, which are then planned individually.

short.prompt: Why do you need a session plan?
short.modelAnswer:
A session plan is a written guide for logical, sequential training. Reasons:
1. It documents the session structure and keeps track of the session.
2. It shows the trainer where they are and where they are going.
3. It gives trainer and learners a clear idea of what they are doing.
4. It records the training session the learners have taken.
5. It gives trainers a firm base to review their performance.

keyPoints.text: A training program is too big for one plan, so it is broken into sessions.

cites.quote: A training program is usually too big to be delivered using only one plan, so it is broken up into a series of shorter training sessions/lesson, which are then planned individually.

keyPoints.text: Each training session will have one or a number of training outcomes.

cites.quote: Each training session will have one or a number of training outcomes,

keyPoints.text: At the end of the session, learners have achieved one portion of the training.
